components.description: Federal FMLA: up to 12 workweeks of unpaid, job-protected leave in a 12-month period for the birth of and care for a child, adoption or foster placement, the employee's own serious health condition, or care of a spouse with a serious health condition. notes: missing is false: UP 102.6 (Family and Medical Leave for Nine-Month Faculty), a governing faculty leave policy covering academic-year (tenure-stream) faculty, is saved and in force on 2018-03-12 (revised 2014-01-07); so are UP 102.15 (personal leave) and UP 102.13 (tenure policies). The no-policy coding (`missing`) does not apply.

Core faculty path (9-month tenure-stream faculty, two years' service): Continuation Pay, paid leave of up to one semester for any FMLA-qualifying condition including birth or care of a newborn (c1), all duties relieved, with FMLA alongside (c2) and an automatic one-year tenure-clock extension (c3). Nine-month faculty earn no sick or annual leave (UP 102.4), so no own-accrual path exists for them.

Birth parent chain: Continuation Pay up to 1 semester (c1), FMLA 12 workweeks concurrent from its start (c2) -> DIPNC disability benefits after Continuation Pay is exhausted (c4, no length) [-> personal leave without pay c7, general-purpose, not counted].

Non-birth parent chain: Continuation Pay up to 1 semester (c1), FMLA 12 workweeks concurrent (c2) -> NC Family Illness leave up to 52 weeks to care for a seriously ill spouse (c6, consecutive_after c1 and c2) [-> personal leave c7, general-purpose].

U8: PIM-5 s. 1 (2018_00) provides unpaid 'Parental Leave' for faculty and staff NOT eligible for FMLA (natural parents of a newborn or adoptive parents), with leave without pay 'shall be granted to the natural mother for the total period of personal disability not covered by sick leave' and 'may be granted' before or after it; recorded in c2's duration_note, not as a component. PIM-5 s. 5 refers faculty to UP 102.6.

UP 102.13 s. 3.7 cites UP 102.6 under an older title ('Leaves of Absence for Members of the Faculty'); the saved UP 102.6 is now 'Family and Medical Leave for Nine-Month Faculty'. PIM-5 and PIM-9 use the same older title.

PIM-9 (2017-07-01 version, in force on 2018-03-12) covers staff and leave-earning employees; it refers 9-month faculty to UP 102.6. The University pays the employer share of medical coverage during FML (benefit continuation, not leave; not a component).
UP 102.13 s. 10.2.1 leaves the effective date blank; the page header states 'EFFECTIVE MAY 20, 2015' and the revision history records the President's approval on May 20, 2015.

Cited but not saved: Reassignment of Duties Program (UP 102.6, 102.15); Educational Leaves of Absence (under development); UP 102.12 Faculty Military Leave (not parental); AA-32 form; Extended Leave of Absence Resource Guide; PIM 29 Shared Leave; OSHR Policy Manual Section 5 (Family Illness Leave, Sick Leave, Vacation Leave); NC State Personnel Manual Section 8; UNC Charlotte Policy Statements #102.7, #102.9, #64; 29 CFR 825; Disability Income Plan of North Carolina; UP 101.16; Academic Personnel Procedures Handbook; Tenured Faculty Performance Review Policy; Principles of Employment for Non-Tenure-Track Faculty.
No passage of the FMLA statute beyond 29 U.S.C. 2611-2612 was needed; FMLA terms verified against statute texts 2026_00 and 2026_01.
